_read_me: Copy to trust-config.json. Fill every pin only after confirming the fingerprint with the provider itself (run: node tools/trust.mjs inspect <downloaded file>). An empty pin list means that source is refused, never trusted blindly. See docs/CREDENTIALS-TRUST.md.

vical._source: AAMVA mDL Digital Trust Service. Free for relying parties; downloading means accepting AAMVA's DTS terms. Landing page: https://vical.dts.aamva.org/ . Put the direct VICAL file URL here once confirmed, or download it and use "file".

masterLists._source: ICAO Master List (https://www.icao.int/icao-pkd/icao-master-list). Signed by ICAO's Master List Signer under the UN CSCA; ICAO provides the UN CSCA certificate on request. Download after accepting ICAO's terms, then point "file" at it.
German Master List from the BSI (https://www.bsi.bund.de/SharedDocs/Downloads/DE/BSI/ElekAusweise/CSCA/GermanMasterList.html), signed under Germany's CSCA.
